item.description:
New

  • Look back at your usage history: open Daily AI Usage › Details and switch to History for daily token trends, quota window timelines, the full model breakdown, and week-by-week comparisons within a month.
  • See your OpenAI organization's token usage and billed costs for the last 7 days in the menu panel: add an Admin Key under Settings › Models & Subscriptions, then choose the organization total or a single API key.
  • Review attention items from the Inbox in the menu panel, now available by default.
  • Antigravity CLI sessions now show a title and jump to their terminal or project folder.

Improved

  • Antigravity CLI usage is now split and priced by the model each step actually used.
  • After you sign in to the Antigravity CLI again, its quota comes back within seconds instead of up to 5 minutes.
  • Codex reset announcements and this Mac's identity now sync to your paired iPhone, so the next Melora Companion update can show them and switch between your Macs.

Fixed

  • Fix quota colors, rows, and captions treating a precise-only reading as missing data in the menu bar and menu panel.
  • Fix the Inbox and menu badge not updating after items were read or archived on iPhone.
  • Fix Settings showing Antigravity as not running when only the Antigravity CLI is in use, and label readings carried over from an earlier refresh as last readings.
  • Fix the fallback steps for finding the melora command in the copyable custom-provider prompt, and low-contrast caption text in Dark Mode.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
